CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, dept_id INTEGER, salary INTEGER)

WITH dept_stats AS (SELECT dept_id, COUNT(*) as emp_count, AVG(salary) as avg_salary FROM employees GROUP BY dept_id) SELECT * FROM dept_stats WHERE emp_count > 1
CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, dept_id INTEGER, salary INTEGER)
INSERT INTO employees VALUES (1, 'Alice', 10, 50000), (2, 'Bob', 20, 60000), (3, 'Charlie', 10, 55000), (4, 'Diana', 30, 70000)
WITH high_salary AS (SELECT * FROM employees WHERE salary >= 60000) SELECT h1.name as name1, h2.name as name2 FROM high_salary h1 CROSS JOIN high_salary h2 WHERE h1.id < h2.id
CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, dept_id INTEGER, salary INTEGER)

WITH sorted_employees AS (SELECT * FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC) SELECT name, salary FROM sorted_employees LIMIT 2

CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, dept_id INTEGER, salary INTEGER)
